term: has intellect (ST I q.14; Lean parameter `HasIntellect` of `GodHasIntellect`)
definition: `HasIntellect g`: g knows, in the sense of ST I q.14 a.1, where immateriality is the reason why a thing knows. In stage 2 group 1 (#198) the predicate is opaque: CATHOLICISM-STAGE2-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES accepts any predicate under this name, so nothing proved there depends on its content.
note: Stage 2 group 3 (#201) gives it content for God through ST I q.14 a.1: what is altogether immaterial has intellect.
